name: c-sponsor-upgrades-aki
input:
Study drug: TX-904 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): headache, rash
Narrative: A 66-year-old man was admitted for 6 days with acute kidney injury (creatinine 3x baseline) on day 30 of dosing. He recovered.
Investigator causality: not related
Sponsor causality: related (reasonable possibility; renal signal in non-clinical studies)

name: c-fatal-listed-sepsis
input:
Study drug: TX-904 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): sepsis, neutropenia
Narrative: A 72-year-old woman developed sepsis on day 12 of dosing and died on day 16.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

name: c-urgent-care-not-admitted
input:
Study drug: TX-115 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): diarrhoea
Narrative: A 40-year-old woman attended the emergency department for 3 hours with dehydration and received IV fluids. She was discharged home and was not admitted.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

name: c-preplanned-cataract
input:
Study drug: TX-115 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): diarrhoea
Narrative: A 68-year-old man was admitted overnight for cataract surgery that was planned before study entry. The cataract had not changed during the study.
Investigator causality: not related
Sponsor causality: not related

name: c-death-outranks-admission
input:
Study drug: TX-226 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): fatigue
Narrative: A 63-year-old man was admitted with a myocardial infarction on day 50 of dosing and died on day 3 of the admission.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

name: c-might-have-been-lt
input:
Study drug: TX-226 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): dizziness
Narrative: A 57-year-old woman was admitted for 2 days with bradycardia (heart rate 42/min). She was haemodynamically stable throughout. The investigator wrote that it 'might have become life-threatening'.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

name: c-agranulocytosis-outpatient
input:
Study drug: TX-337 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): nausea
Narrative: Routine laboratory tests showed agranulocytosis (neutrophils 0.2 x10^9/L) in a 44-year-old man. He was managed as an outpatient with G-CSF and recovered.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

name: c-prolonged-stay
input:
Study drug: TX-337 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): headache
Narrative: A 59-year-old woman already in hospital for a planned procedure had her stay prolonged by 5 days because of a pulmonary embolism. She was haemodynamically stable and never at immediate risk of death.
Investigator causality: not related
Sponsor causality: related
